title: Does the CoT Monitoring Advantage Hold for Smaller Reasoning Models?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Clear chain: if CoT monitoring doesn't add value at 7B scale, safety protocols must differ by model scale. Many real deployments use smaller models, so this directly informs practical monitoring decisions.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: DeepSeek-R1-7B and Llama-3.1-8B are open-source and runnable on medium compute. SHADE-Arena and MALT are publicly available. The paired comparison (CoT vs. action-only on two models) is a well-structured experiment accessible to beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Two models times two monitor conditions times two task suites (SHADE-Arena, MALT). Could be narrowed to one task suite and two models for a tighter scope. Achievable in 30 hours with focused execution.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
